name: Scroll Cross Fade
description: Scroll-driven gallery where a small image box drifts down beside a tall image while its two photos cross fade, with a caption and a progress indicator, alternating sides per section.
contents: List of sections, each with a caption title and description
Per section a small box with two cross fading images and a tall side image
Two-part progress indicator on each small box
behavior: Two images in each small box cross fade with scroll using GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub
On screens 768px and wider the small box travels along the tall image while scrolling
Progress indicator fills and grows as the section passes the viewport center
Sections alternate left and right and swap column widths every two sections
Below 768px the layout stacks and each box fades on its own scroll position
editableByProps: Number of sections, captions, and all three images per section with alt text
Background, text and caption colors as Tailwind classes

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the breakpoint between stacked and side-by-side behavior
needsCodeEdit.where: mm.add calls with max-width 767px and min-width 768px

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the fade range of the images
Change progress indicator color or size

fixed: Image boxes use mix-blend-plus-lighter, which looks best on a dark background
Alternating layout pattern is derived from the section index
Each section is at least one screen tall to give the scroll range
